author: SickProdigy
description: Prepare and orchestrate reviewed Base Clanker launches with interactive drafts, optional vaults and airdrops, and explicit wallet execution boundaries.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild launch configuration and bounded token launch audit records, including the requester identity until Red requests its deletion. Requester identity is then anonymized. It does not store private keys, seed phrases, API tokens, or wallet credentials.
install_msg: Configure `[p]clankerset treasury`, `[p]clankerset enabled true`, and the desired launch controls. Base Sepolia is enabled; the Base mainnet release candidate remains default-off behind installation pause and code gates. Use `[p]clank <symbol> [token name]` to start a requester-bound draft and review its exact wallet execution card.
name: Clanker
short: Reviewed Base launches, token rundowns, rewards, and owner controls
